movie.overview: For five men, the opportunity to share a penthouse in the city -- in which to carry on extramarital affairs -- is a dream come true, until the dead body of an unknown woman turns up. Realizing that her killer must be one of their group, the men are gripped by paranoia as each one suspects another.
movie.tagline: The right place to do wrong.
movie.title: The Loft

recommendations.title: Unfaithful
recommendations.overview: A New York suburban couple's marriage goes dangerously awry when the wife indulges in an adulterous fling.

recommendations.title: Careful What You Wish For
recommendations.overview: A guy gets more than he bargained for after entering into an affair with the wife of an investment banker. Soon, a suspicious death and substantial life insurance policy embroil him in a scandal.

recommendations.title: Graphic Desires
recommendations.overview: When reclusive Franklin cheats on his partner with a mysterious girl he meets on a dating app, it becomes the start of a deadly obsession.

recommendations.title: Addicted
recommendations.overview: A gallerist risks her family and flourishing career when she enters into an affair with a talented painter and slowly loses control of her life.

recommendations.title: An Affair to Die For
recommendations.overview: A weekend get-away for two lovers turns into a nightmare of psychological mind games when their infidelity is discovered.

recommendations.title: Deep Water
recommendations.overview: A well-to-do husband who allows his wife to have affairs in order to avoid a divorce becomes a prime suspect in the disappearance of her lovers.

recommendations.title: Gone Girl
recommendations.overview: With his wife's disappearance having become the focus of an intense media circus, a man sees the spotlight turned on him when it's suspected that he may not be innocent.

recommendations.title: Dream Lover
recommendations.overview: Not long after they cross paths at an art gallery, architect Ray Reardon and hypnotically sensual Lena are married with children. But as strange incidents occur, Ray begins to realize he may not really know the woman he married.

recommendations.title: Bone Lake
recommendations.overview: A couple’s romantic vacation at a secluded lakeside estate is upended when they are forced to share the mansion with a mysterious and attractive couple. In this darkly hilarious and seductive horror story, a dream getaway spirals into a nightmarish maze of sex, lies, and manipulation, bringing terrifying secrets to light and triggering a bloody battle for survival.

recommendations.title: Buried Alive
recommendations.overview: A married woman and her lover plot to kill her husband to make off with the insurance money. However, their attempt to murder him using poisonous fish toxins backfires in surprising ways.

recommendations.title: Adulterers
recommendations.overview: On a steamy New Orleans afternoon, Sam Deuprey decides to surprise his beautiful wife, Ashley, for their anniversary and comes home early. But Ashley is not alone in the bedroom. She and her lover, Damien are about to learn how far a jealous husband will go.

recommendations.title: Reptile
recommendations.overview: Following the brutal murder of a young real estate agent, a hardened detective attempts to uncover the truth in a case where nothing is as it seems, and by doing so dismantles the illusions in his own life.

recommendations.title: Basic Instinct
recommendations.overview: Catherine, a novelist with an insatiable sexual appetite, becomes a prime suspect when her boyfriend is brutally murdered -- a crime she had described in her latest story.

recommendations.title: Fatal Attraction
recommendations.overview: A married man's one-night stand comes back to haunt him when that lover begins to stalk him and his family.

recommendations.title: Blood Simple
recommendations.overview: The owner of a seedy small-town Texas bar discovers that one of his employees is having an affair with his wife. A chaotic chain of misunderstandings, lies and mischief ensues after he devises a plot to have them murdered.

recommendations.title: Butterfly on a Wheel
recommendations.overview: A sociopathic kidnapper methodically pushes a desperate pair of parents to their absolute breaking point.

recommendations.title: The Ledge
recommendations.overview: A thriller in which a battle of philosophies between a fundamentalist Christian and an atheist who shares an apartment with a gay friend escalates into a lethal battle of wills.

recommendations.title: The Number 23
recommendations.overview: Animal control officer Walter Sparrow becomes obsessed with a novel that he believes was written about him, as more and more similarities between himself and his literary alter ego seem to arise.

recommendations.title: Watcher
recommendations.overview: As a serial killer stalks the city, Julia — a young actress who just moved to town with her husband — notices a mysterious stranger watching her from across the street.

recommendations.title: Sleuth
recommendations.overview: A man who loves games and theatre invites his wife's lover to meet, setting up a battle of wits with potentially deadly results.
